category: DDL index, Chinese-language (software, tutorials, ebooks; Baidu Pan links)

free_tier.stated: The index is free to read and its RSS feed answers with application/rss+xml. The download is not free: a post prints a notice that the resource is VIP-only and asks the reader to log in first.
free_tier.notes: The Chinese notice in the post read is 抱歉，此资源仅限VIP下载，请先登录.

retention.stated: Posts persist and the feed carries the latest items; the Pan link behind a post dies with the uploader's quota.

egress.terms: No byte allowance from the index; downloads are served by Baidu Pan (pan.baidu.com) behind the post's VIP link.

interface_detail: WordPress RSS at /feed/ (application/rss+xml) plus an HTML category tree; wp-login.php is the door the VIP notice points at. No JSON API found.
tooling: An RSS reader reads the index. The links are Baidu Pan URLs, which need a Pan account and a client that speaks Baidu's protocol; a plain HTTP GET does not.
chaining: Feed to post to VIP link to Baidu Pan. Complements the English DDL feeds because the software catalogue and the Chinese-language tutorials do not overlap with them.

limits.value: every download link in the post read was replaced by the VIP notice, and the archive password is the fixed string '0daydown'

limits_note: The index itself answered without an account; only the link is gated. The 794-word home page and the feed are fully readable.
binding_note: Nothing is metered in bytes on the index; the first thing that stops the client is the paid VIP gate on the link itself.

identity_cost.detail: An account plus a VIP purchase stands between the client and the link. The registration form was not opened, so the payment rail is unverified.

reliability_note: Baidu Pan links die with the uploader's account and are shaped by region; posts share a fixed archive password ('0daydown') which must be applied before the file opens.
confidence_note: Home page, feed headers and one post were read on 2026-10-23. Purchasing a VIP account would settle the payment rail and the real per-link quota.

evidence.proved: live Chinese-language DDL index with categories such as tutorials and software, newest post timestamped 11 seconds before the read
content-type application/rss+xml, so the index has a machine-readable feed
VIP-only download notice in place of the link, and 'Password/解压密码 0daydown' in the post body

notes: Recorded because an English-language pass would not surface it: the feed is reachable, the catalogue is software and courses rather than video, and the download path is Baidu Pan, which no English DDL index uses.
